title: doc-amender-prompt.md runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for doc-amender-prompt.md files — operator-authored prompt assets consumed by the doc-amender skill when round-tripping amendments through staging-emit. Prompts ship outside-vault as state-tier assets under $VAULT_WRITER_STATE_ROOT/prompts/*.md. Declares the foundation-shipped variable namespace the prompt body may reference; declares the 3-signal survivorship policy (operator-edit-wins + amender-conflict-sidecar + amender-paused-frontmatter). The v1.1.0 contract ADDS persistence_mode (deterministic|llm-mediated|hybrid) — the det/LLM split the runtime dispatches on; deterministic → the compose-deterministic.sh lane, llm-mediated → the claude -p lane, hybrid → append-section+llm_control. Companion contract to skills/doc-amender.
matcher_rationale: No pillar or schema entry matches these files: prompt assets live outside the vault, beyond the vault-scoped frontmatter registry's reach, and governance/mandatory-files-rules.json declares mandates for the vault _index.md, the MEMORY.md cap and the vault-writer reference only. This contract is SELF-declaring — its own frontmatter_required/optional/enums are the matcher — and is read by skills/doc-amender/process.sh; matcher_entry is null because a non-JSON matcher has no entry to anchor into.

_design_notes.lockstep_pair: skills/doc-amender (the runtime that reads this contract). The foundation ships governance/doc-dependencies.json :: entries[] EMPTY — writer-fan-in entries are adopter-registered, so no shipped entry moves in lockstep with this contract.
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: R-37 atomic lockstep with doc-amender skill + any adopter-registered writer-fan-in doc-deps entries

persistence_mode_detail._description: Persistence-mode contract-extension (the det/LLM split). persistence_mode selects the composition lane the doc-amender runtime dispatches to (skills/doc-amender/process.sh :: resolve_persistence_mode). When a prompt omits persistence_mode, the runtime DERIVES it from amendment_strategy via persistence_mode_default below (the mapping is the CONTRACT's, not hand-coded in the composer). EXTENDS the already-shipped contract — no new artifact.

modes.deterministic: No claude -p. The skills/doc-amender/compose-deterministic.sh composes via table-fill (upsert a row by key; replace-on-key) + capped-append; emits an amender-replacement packet back to staging (NEVER writes the destination — R-34).
modes.llm-mediated: The claude -p lane (skills/doc-amender/process.sh). The operator-authored prompt body is run through the model with the 6-variable context block; output is round-tripped as an amender-replacement packet.
modes.hybrid: append-section + llm_control — appends a section with LLM-mediated section composition.

persistence_mode_default._note: amendment_strategy ↔ persistence_mode mapping (the contract's, consumed by resolve_persistence_mode + compose-deterministic.sh). A prompt MAY override with an explicit persistence_mode frontmatter value.

pattern_menu.decision-log: amendment_strategy=append-section → persistence_mode=hybrid (append-section + llm_control; create-if-absent / error-sidecar-if-multiple section_key)

signals.name: operator-edit-wins
signals.trigger: Existing operator-edit-wins two-signal detection (last_user_edit timestamp + content-diff against writer's last-known-hash)
signals.action: Amender SKIPS LLM call; emits _amender-conflict.json sidecar

signals.name: amender-conflict-sidecar
signals.action: Sidecar file at <destination>.amender-conflict.json; operator triages via /amend-accept <sidecar> skill

signals.name: amender-paused-frontmatter
signals.trigger: Destination file frontmatter declares amender_paused: true
signals.action: Amender permanently skips this destination until operator removes the flag

survivorship_policy_detail.boundary: doc-amender NEVER writes destination directly; round-trips through staging via staging-emit
